name: io.forthclear/liquidation
title: ForthClear Liquidation Marketplace
description: Search surplus, overstock and returned lots, request quotes, and check out via OAuth or API key.

tools.name: search_inventory
tools.description: Keyword search of published, in-stock surplus listings. No sign-in required. `query` matches the name, description, brand, SKU, and category as whole words, in any order. A title or category match ranks above a description mention. A whole query that names a category (electronics, clothes, home goods, kitchen appliances) is that category filter. A whole query that names a condition (customer returns, shelf pulls, overstock, salvage, refurbished) is that condition filter. Common goods also match synonyms, such as headphones and earbuds, or cooling and a fan. `category` is a catalogue category such as electronics or home_goods. `condition` is salvage, customer_returns, shelf_pulls, overstock, or new_or_refurbished. `min_price` and `max_price` are unit prices in cents. `min_quantity` is the minimum units available. `ship_from` or `location` limits where the lot ships from, such as US or Michigan. When nothing matches, products is empty and next_step tells you to call post_wanted_request. The reply includes post_request_url. For a sentence about what you want, use search_inventory_semantic.

query.description: Words to match, or a category name such as electronics or clothes. Not a sentence — use search_inventory_semantic for that. `q` is accepted as an alias.

category.description: Limit to one catalogue category. One of: electronics, apparel, home_goods, beauty, sports, kitchenware, office_supplies, toys, food_beverage, tools, industrial_materials, other. Prose such as "Electronics" or "clothes" is accepted and mapped to the stored value.

condition.description: Condition of the goods: salvage (sold as-is), customer returns, shelf pulls, overstock, or new or refurbished.

min_price.description: Minimum unit price in cents. 500 means $5.00.

max_price.description: Maximum unit price in cents. 5000 means $50.00.

min_quantity.description: Minimum units available on the lot. 50 means at least 50 units in stock.

ship_from.description: Where the lot ships from. A country code such as US, or a state or region such as Michigan. `location` is an alias.

offset.description: How many matching listings to skip. Use with has_more to see the next page.

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Read one listing: description, price, quantity, condition, photo, and whether instant checkout is available. No sign-in required. Use this before requesting a quote or buying. Pass the exact id from search, for example product_2731.

product_id.description: Exact id from search, for example product_2731. productId, id, and slug are aliases.

slug.description: Alias for product_id. Public listing slug, such as surplus-lot-2731.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Ask a seller to price a bulk order. No sign-in required. Signed-in buyers can omit buyer_email; it defaults to the account email, which is where the seller replies. Anonymous callers must pass buyer_email. Anonymous requests are limited to 5 per hour. Save status_token and pass it to get_quote_status. This does not charge a card. Sensitive: requires user approval each time.

product_id.description: Exact id from search, for example product_2731. productId, id, and slug are aliases.

slug.description: Alias for product_id. Public listing slug.

buyer_email.description: Where the seller replies. Required when the caller is not signed in. Optional when signed in; defaults to the account email.

target_price.description: Target price per unit in cents (optional)

idempotency_key.description: Required. 8–200 characters (letters, digits, . _ : -). The same key returns the original result for 24 hours and is sent to Stripe as Idempotency-Key.

tools.name: get_quote_status
tools.description: Check a quote you requested: pending, responded, accepted, rejected, or completed, plus the seller price and shipping once they reply. No sign-in required when you pass the status_token from request_quote. Signed-in buyers can also read their own quotes without the token.

tools.name: create_listing
tools.description: Publish a surplus lot for sale. Requires sign-in with seller access. Provide a title, category, condition, quantity, and price per unit. OAuth discovery: /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (scope seller:write). Sensitive: requires user approval each time.

name.description: Listing title shown to buyers and matched by catalogue search.

description.description: Listing body copy: condition detail, packaging, lot composition. Buyers filter on its presence and agents summarise it.

category.description: Catalogue category. One of: electronics, apparel, home_goods, beauty, sports, kitchenware, office_supplies, toys, food_beverage, tools, industrial_materials, other.

condition.description: Condition of the goods: salvage (sold as-is), customer returns, shelf pulls, overstock, or new or refurbished.

sku.description: Seller's own stock-keeping unit, shown to buyers and used for reconciliation.

idempotency_key.description: Required. 8–200 characters (letters, digits, . _ : -). The same key returns the original result for 24 hours and is sent to Stripe as Idempotency-Key.

tools.name: get_pricing_recommendation
tools.description: Suggest a liquidation unit price in cents from MSRP, condition, category, and lot size. No sign-in required. original_retail is MSRP per unit in cents. Larger lots suggest a lower per-unit price. The result is bounded below retail. This does not change any listing's price.

category.description: Catalogue category. One of: electronics, apparel, home_goods, beauty, sports, kitchenware, office_supplies, toys, food_beverage, tools, industrial_materials, other.

condition.description: Condition of the goods: salvage (sold as-is), customer returns, shelf pulls, overstock, or new or refurbished.

original_retail.description: MSRP per unit in cents. 5000 means $50.00. Required, and must be greater than zero.

quantity.description: Units in the lot. Larger lots get a lower per-unit suggestion. Omit for a small lot.

tools.name: get_quote_requests
tools.description: List quote requests buyers sent you. Requires sign-in with seller access. Filter to pending, responded, or all. OAuth discovery: /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (scope seller:read).

status.description: Which of the calling seller's quote requests to return: pending (awaiting a reply), responded, or all.

tools.name: respond_to_quote
tools.description: Answer a quote from a buyer by accepting it, sending a counter-price, or declining. Requires sign-in with seller access. The buyer is notified. OAuth discovery: /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (scope seller:write). Sensitive: requires user approval each time.

quote_request_id.description: Id of the quote request to answer, as returned by get_quote_requests.

action.description: accept the buyer's terms as asked, counter with a different price (requires counter_price), or decline the request.

counter_price.description: Counter offer price in cents (for counter action)

message.description: Optional note sent to the buyer alongside the decision.

tools.name: bulk_update_listings
tools.description: Change the price or the minimum order quantity on up to 200 of your listings. Requires sign-in with seller access. price_set takes price_cents (integer cents). value_usd is an explicit dollar amount and is deprecated. The percent modes adjust the current price, and moq_set writes a minimum order quantity. Previous values are replaced. OAuth discovery: /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (scope seller:write). Sensitive: requires user approval each time.

mode.description: What to change and how: price_set writes an absolute unit price in cents via price_cents, price_percent_increase / price_percent_decrease adjust the current price by a percentage, moq_set writes a minimum order quantity.

price_cents.description: For price_set only. Absolute unit price in cents. 5000 means $50.00.

value_usd.description: Deprecated. For price_set only, an explicit price in US dollars. Prefer price_cents.

value.description: Percent (0-1000) for percent modes, or integer units (1-999999) for moq_set. Not accepted for price_set.

tools.name: set_listing_shipping
tools.description: Set how your listings ship: the shipping price per unit, or that shipping is quoted per order, and the lot type (parcel, pallet, truckload or mixed). Optionally set where your stock ships from; that is part of your seller account and shows on all your listings. Requires sign-in with seller access. Up to 200 of your listings per call; every id must be yours or nothing changes. shipping_price_cents is charged per unit at checkout (0 means free shipping). quote_shipping=true removes the fixed price so buyers ask for a quote, and turns off instant checkout on those listings, because instant checkout needs a fixed shipping price. OAuth discovery: /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (scope seller:write). Sensitive: requires user approval each time.

product_ids.description: Your ForthClear product ids (max 200 per call).

shipping_price_cents.description: Shipping price per unit in cents, charged per unit at checkout. 0 means free shipping. Not with quote_shipping.

quote_shipping.description: true: no fixed shipping price; buyers request a quote that includes shipping. Turns off instant checkout on these listings. Not with shipping_price_cents.

lot_type.description: How the lot ships: parcel (boxes by courier), pallet, truckload, or mixed.

ship_from_country.description: Two-letter country code your stock ships from, for example US. Applies to your whole seller account.

ship_from_region.description: Optional state or region your stock ships from, for example Michigan. Applies to your whole seller account. Only with ship_from_country.

tools.name: bulk_mark_shipped
tools.description: Mark up to 200 of your orders as shipped, with an optional tracking number, tracking link, and carrier applied to the whole batch. Requires sign-in with seller access. Tracking you supply replaces tracking already on those orders, and each buyer is notified. OAuth discovery: /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (scope seller:write). Sensitive: requires user approval each time.

order_ids.description: Order ids belonging to the calling seller (max 200/request). Orders owned by anyone else are skipped.

tracking_number.description: Tracking number written to every listed order. Supplying this without carrier_name auto-detects the carrier.

tracking_url.description: Tracking URL written to every listed order.

carrier_name.description: Carrier for the shipment. Omit to infer it from tracking_number.

tools.name: bulk_export_orders
tools.description: Download your orders as CSV, with order id, product, buyer, quantity, total, status, and date. Requires sign-in with seller access. Only orders you own are included. OAuth discovery: /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (scope seller:read).

order_ids.description: Order ids belonging to the calling seller (max 200/request). Orders owned by anyone else are skipped.

tools.name: seller_inbox_summarise
tools.description: Summarise your seller inbox: quotes waiting for a reply, orders that may miss their ship-by date, and orders with reported problems. Requires sign-in with seller access. Use it to decide what to answer or ship next. OAuth discovery: /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (scope seller:read).

window_hours.description: Look-ahead window for ship-by-date risk detection (default 24h).

limit.description: Max items to surface in each bucket.

tools.name: quick_buy
tools.description: Price an instant checkout for one listing. This does not charge the card. When the signed-in buyer has a saved card and the total is under US$1,000, the result is a summary (items, shipping, total, seller) plus a confirmation_token. Call confirm_purchase with that token and payment.saved_card true to charge the saved card. If there is no saved card, or the card needs authentication (including charges of US$1,000 or more), the result includes the existing checkout link instead. The listing's seller sells the goods. ForthClear runs the marketplace and Stripe processes the payment. buyer_email is required. quantity must be a positive integer below the listing's quote threshold (quote_quantity_threshold from get_product_details). A threshold of 1 means no quantity can be bought instantly. Use request_quote. The listing must have instant checkout and a shipping price. Requires sign-in with buyer access. OAuth discovery: /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (scope buyer:purchase). Sensitive: requires user approval each time.

product_id.description: Exact id from search, for example product_2731. productId, id, and slug are aliases.

slug.description: Alias for product_id. Public listing slug.

idempotency_key.description: Required. 8–200 characters (letters, digits, . _ : -). The same key returns the original result for 24 hours and is sent to Stripe as Idempotency-Key.

tools.name: search_inventory_semantic
tools.description: Find listings by describing what you want in everyday language, such as returned kitchen appliances in bulk. No sign-in required. Semantic matches include similarity from 0 to 1 and match_type semantic. When the embedding index is empty or no provider is configured, results use keyword search, similarity is null, and match_type is keyword_fallback. category, when set, is one catalogue category such as electronics. max_price is the maximum unit price in cents. When nothing matches, products is empty and next_step tells you to call post_wanted_request.

query.description: Natural-language description of what the buyer wants. `q` is accepted as an alias.

category.description: Limit to one catalogue category. One of: electronics, apparel, home_goods, beauty, sports, kitchenware, office_supplies, toys, food_beverage, tools, industrial_materials, other.

condition.description: Condition of the goods: salvage (sold as-is), customer returns, shelf pulls, overstock, or new or refurbished.

max_price.description: Maximum price per unit in cents

limit.description: Number of ranked results to return

tools.name: post_wanted_request
tools.description: Post what a buyer needs when search finds nothing, so sellers can quote them. No sign-in required. A signed-in buyer can omit email. An anonymous caller passes buyer_email. This saves the request. It does not send an email.

query.description: What the buyer wants, in their words. `what` and `q` are accepted as aliases.

buyer_email.description: Required when the caller is not signed in. Where a seller can reply.

quantity.description: How many units they want. Optional.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Check status, tracking, and the inspection deadline for an order you placed. Requires sign-in with buyer access. OAuth discovery: /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (scope buyer:read).

tools.name: open_dispute
tools.description: Report a problem with an order. not_received is allowed while the order is marked shipped. Other reasons require a delivered order waiting for confirmation. This records the issue, pauses the seller payout, and notifies ForthClear. Requires sign-in with buyer access. OAuth discovery: /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (scope buyer:write). Sensitive: requires user approval each time.

reason.description: Dispute reason. not_received is allowed while the order is shipped. The other reasons require delivered_pending_confirmation.

idempotency_key.description: Required. 8–200 characters (letters, digits, . _ : -). The same key returns the original result for 24 hours and is sent to Stripe as Idempotency-Key.

tools.name: subscribe_to_query
tools.description: Save a catalogue search and receive new matching listings by email, webhook, or a pollable feed. Requires sign-in with buyer access. OAuth discovery: /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (scope buyer:write).

query.description: Marketplace filter. Prices are US dollars per unit. Omit a field to leave it unset.

search.description: Words to match in the listing name, description, brand, or SKU.

category.description: Catalogue category. One of: electronics, apparel, home_goods, beauty, sports, kitchenware, office_supplies, toys, food_beverage, tools, industrial_materials, other.

minPrice.description: Minimum unit price in US dollars. 50 means $50.

maxPrice.description: Maximum unit price in US dollars. 50 means $50.

minQuantity.description: Minimum units available on the listing.

bulkDealsOnly.description: When true, only listings that have a bulk price tier.

sellerCountry.description: Seller country, as stored on the seller account (name or 2-letter code).

condition.description: Condition of the goods: salvage (sold as-is), customer returns, shelf pulls, overstock, or new or refurbished.

sort.description: Result order: newest, price_low, price_high, quantity_low, quantity_high, discount_desc, lot_total_low, or lot_total_high.

channels.description: Where to send new matches. One to five entries. Each entry is a webhook (public https URL), an email address, or mcp_resource (poll the returned feed).

type.description: Deliver matches by HTTP POST to url.

url.description: Public https URL that receives new matches. Private and loopback addresses are rejected.

type.description: Keep matches on a pollable feed. The response includes poll_url.

tools.name: search_suppliers
tools.description: Search the supplier directory. No sign-in required. Returns published company profiles only, including profiles a company has claimed. These are not lots for sale. A profile is compiled from public sources and is not an endorsement. Use search_inventory to find lots you can buy. Filter with query, country, type (3pl, returns_processor, brand_retailer, liquidator, other), or category.

query.description: Words to match against the company name, city, or summary. `q` is accepted as an alias.

country.description: Country name or 2-letter code, matched exactly.

category.description: One category the profile lists, such as apparel or electronics.

tools.name: preview_checkout
tools.description: Read the seller of record, unit price, shipping, tax, and total for an instant-checkout listing. Does not charge a card. Requires buyer read access. Pass the returned checkout_id to confirm_purchase. Requires sign-in with buyer access. OAuth discovery: /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (scope buyer:read).

product_id.description: Exact id from search, for example product_2731. productId, id, and slug are aliases.

slug.description: Alias for product_id. Public listing slug.

quantity.description: Units to buy. Must be below the quote threshold.

shipping_address_id.description: Optional. Shipping is the listing's shipping price; tax is not collected on this path.

idempotency_key.description: Required. 8–200 characters (letters, digits, . _ : -). The same key returns the original result for 24 hours and is sent to Stripe as Idempotency-Key.

tools.name: confirm_purchase
tools.description: Charge the previewed checkout with the signed-in buyer's own saved card, off session, or with a Stripe shared payment token when the SDK supports it. Pass confirmation_token from quick_buy or preview_checkout. A token or total that does not match the summary is rejected and nothing is charged. The same idempotency key does not create a second charge. Charges of US$1,000 or more, and cards that need authentication, return requires_action plus a checkout link. Returns confirmed only after the PaymentIntent succeeds and the order exists. Requires sign-in with buyer access. OAuth discovery: /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (scope buyer:purchase). Sensitive: requires user approval each time.

confirmation_token.description: confirmation_token from the summary. Must match that checkout. A mismatch is rejected.

payment.description: shared_payment_token when the Stripe SDK supports it, or saved_card true.

saved_card.description: Charge the card saved on the ForthClear account.

idempotency_key.description: Required. 8–200 characters (letters, digits, . _ : -). The same key returns the original result for 24 hours and is sent to Stripe as Idempotency-Key.

tools.name: get_saved_card
tools.description: Read whether the signed-in buyer has a card saved for in-chat checkout, and return the page where they can add one. Does not charge the card. Card numbers are not returned. Requires buyer read access. Requires sign-in with buyer access. OAuth discovery: /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (scope buyer:read).

tools.name: list_my_orders
tools.description: List orders the signed-in buyer placed. Requires buyer read access. Requires sign-in with buyer access. OAuth discovery: /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (scope buyer:read).

tools.name: list_seller_orders
tools.description: List orders for the signed-in seller. Requires seller read access. Returns order id, status, quantity, and total. Buyer contact details stay on the order page. Requires sign-in with seller access. OAuth discovery: /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (scope seller:read).

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an unshipped order whose ship-by date has passed, for a full refund. Seller Agreement §5.4. Requires buyer purchase access. Requires sign-in with buyer access. OAuth discovery: /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (scope buyer:purchase). Sensitive: requires user approval each time.

idempotency_key.description: Required. 8–200 characters (letters, digits, . _ : -). The same key returns the original result for 24 hours and is sent to Stripe as Idempotency-Key.

tools.name: mark_order_received
tools.description: Mark a shipped order received. This starts the 3-day inspection window and does not pay the seller. Requires buyer write access. Requires sign-in with buyer access. OAuth discovery: /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (scope buyer:write).

idempotency_key.description: Required. 8–200 characters (letters, digits, . _ : -). The same key returns the original result for 24 hours and is sent to Stripe as Idempotency-Key.

tools.name: confirm_order
tools.description: End the inspection window after it has elapsed. A live order then starts the seller payout. A sandbox order is marked delivered and is not paid out. Requires buyer write access. Requires sign-in with buyer access. OAuth discovery: /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (scope buyer:write).

idempotency_key.description: Required. 8–200 characters (letters, digits, . _ : -). The same key returns the original result for 24 hours and is sent to Stripe as Idempotency-Key.

tools.name: get_dispute_status
tools.description: Read the claim on an order you placed. Requires buyer read access. Requires sign-in with buyer access. OAuth discovery: /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (scope buyer:read).

tools.name: list_my_quotes
tools.description: List quote requests for the signed-in buyer. Requires buyer read access. Requires sign-in with buyer access. OAuth discovery: /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (scope buyer:read).

tools.name: accept_quote_and_pay
tools.description: Accept a seller's quoted price and charge it with the same payment options as confirm_purchase. Requires buyer purchase access. Requires sign-in with buyer access. OAuth discovery: /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (scope buyer:purchase). Sensitive: requires user approval each time.

quote_id.description: Quote id from list_my_quotes or get_quote_status.

idempotency_key.description: Required. 8–200 characters (letters, digits, . _ : -). The same key returns the original result for 24 hours and is sent to Stripe as Idempotency-Key.
